newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peace Hill eases 5.4 pct as trade resumes.
newsitem.headline: Peace Hill eases 5.4 pct as trade resumes.

text.p: Shares of Peace Hill Enterprise Group Ltd eased 20 cents, or 5.40 percent, to HK$3.50 on Friday as trading resumed after being suspended on Thursday.

Peace Hill and its parent Red Hill Co Ltd said in a statement Red Hill and Kong Fa Holding Ltd agreed to put forward the completion date of a share sales option, if exercised, to on or before November 15 from November 29 with other changes.

Red Hill agreed in October to sell an option to take all its 67.22 percent stake at Peace Hill to Kong Fa for HK$174.77 million. Kong Fa will be required to make a general offer of Peace Hill shares, if the option is exercised.

The companies further agreed in a supplemental agreement dated October 4 to cancel the HK$30 million iterim consideration set on the option agreement and instead lifted the final payment to HK$128 million from HK$98 million.
Trading on Peace Hill, a beverages maker and distributor, was suspended on Thursday pending for announcement.
